verdict.rationale: Docs show limited export options—notes can be exported to Google Docs/Sheets and Audio Overviews can be downloaded for offline playback—but there is no evidence of a comprehensive export of all notebook data (sources, chat history, citations) in open, portable formats, nor any documented account-deletion/data-portability workflow. Missing for 10: full source/chat export, open-format bulk export, documented data portability/deletion process, independent verification of export completeness.
